R409.note: Replaces raw NetworkStream inline-protocol writes with StackExchange.Redis StringSet, which RESP-frames key/value so embedded CRLF cannot split commands; constructor now needs an IConnectionMultiplexer instead of TcpClient, which the write-up discloses and does not affect the shown call chain's behavior.

R410.note: Normalizes destination once (toAbsolutePath+normalize) before resolving/containment-checking each entry, matching the stated contract; valid nested extraction and rejection of escaping entries both preserved.

R411.note: proc_open() with an array command (PHP 7.4+) executes ping without shell interpretation, closing the injection; host is still passed as ping's trailing argument in both old and new code so no new option-injection surface is introduced by the fix.

R412.note: Verified by running net/http.CrossOriginProtection (Go 1.25.5) that the zero-value &http.CrossOriginProtection{} does not panic and correctly allows same-origin/Sec-Fetch-Site requests while rejecting cross-origin ones, matching the fix's claims; Origin check retained as stated secondary layer.

R413.note: Validates every member's resolved path against the resolved base directory before extracting, the standard workaround for Python 3.11 lacking extractall(filter='data'); does not separately check symlink member targets but that is outside the reported path-traversal-via-member-name finding.

R414.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) bounds the write exactly as CWE-787 remediation calls for; truncation on overlong input is the expected, disclosed behavior of the standard fix.

R415.note: Eliminates the shell sink entirely by switching to the sharp library, but sharp's default resize fit is 'cover' (crops to exact WxH) whereas ImageMagick's plain WxH geometry preserves aspect ratio without cropping (fits within the box) - an undisclosed change in the thumbnail's visible output.

R416.note: WHERE id = ANY($1) with the ids array bound as a single pg parameter is the idiomatic parameterized replacement for a hand-built IN(...) list and matches the stated contract.

R417.note: Build FAILS: SimpleEvaluationContext has no setRootObject(); the root object must be supplied via expression.getValue(context, rootObject) instead, so the write-up's claimed fix does not compile and the preview endpoint cannot run at all, which the write-up does not flag.

R418.note: Adds a straightforward bounds check (playerIndex >= MAX_PLAYERS) before the array write; function was already void so silently dropping out-of-range updates changes nothing observable for valid callers.

R419.note: Switches Runtime.exec(String) concatenation to the array form Runtime.exec(String[]), which does not invoke a shell and closes the reported metacharacter injection; behavior for legitimate data values is unchanged.

R420.note: Replaces string.Format concatenation with SqlCommand.Parameters.Add(@ownerName, SqlDbType.NVarChar), the standard parameterized-query fix; return value and error handling unchanged as stated.

R421.note: Swaps abspath() for realpath() so symlinks are resolved before the containment check, closing the reported symlink-escape vector while leaving the rest of the contract (nested paths, fail-closed, download_name) untouched.

R422.note: Build FAILS (CS0103: SqlDbType not found) because the file never adds `using System.Data;`; the parameterized-query approach is otherwise correct but the code as written cannot compile, so the endpoint cannot run at all.

R423.note: Reproduced against real EF Core (Sqlite provider): ExecuteSqlRawAsync(sql, accountId, status, beforeUtc) with named placeholders @accountId/@status/@beforeUtc in the SQL text throws InvalidOperationException ('Must add values for the following parameters') on every call, because EF Core's raw-SQL parameter binding maps plain positional object values to {0}/{1}-style placeholders, not to named text already in the SQL string; the archive operation never succeeds for any caller, which the write-up does not disclose and incorrectly claims preserves the contract.
